# Rasmiranjan Sahoo

> Freelance full-stack developer (Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India — working worldwide)
> specialising in React, Next.js, React Native/Expo, Node.js and Gen-AI integration.

## Summary

Rasmiranjan Sahoo is a freelance full-stack and mobile developer available for
contract work internationally. His flagship project is the Vedrastores
e-commerce ecosystem for the Kenyan market: four interconnected web platforms
and two React Native apps, including M-Pesa payment integration, designed and
built single-handedly in four months.

## Services

- Web application development — Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Mobile app development — React Native, Expo (Android and iOS)
- E-commerce and multi-vendor marketplace development
- Payment integration — M-Pesa (Safaricom Daraja API)
- Generative AI integration — OpenAI API, LangChain, agentic SDKs
- Backend and infrastructure — Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase, AWS S3/CloudFront

## Notable work

- **Vedrastores Ecosystem** (2026, Kenya) — https://rasmiranjan.in/works/vedrastores
  Multi-vendor e-commerce infrastructure: marketing site, buyer portal, vendor
  dashboard and admin panel, plus buyer and rider mobile apps.
  Stack: Next.js, React Native, Expo, Shadcn UI, Node.js, Firebase, AWS, M-Pesa.
  Outcome: 4 web platforms + 2 apps shipped in 4 months by a single developer.
  Live: https://vedrastores.co.ke
